title: Verdant Melodies

outfit_card.silhouette: A pastoral layered ensemble featuring a mint pinafore with ruffled shoulder straps over a lace-trimmed ivory blouse, cinched at the waist with a sash, and paired with a voluminous bell skirt.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Wide-brimmed woven straw hat adorned with clustered pink roses, greenery, and a ruffled lavender ribbon trim.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Ivory lace blouse with a square neckline and sheer ruffled cap sleeves, overlaid with a mint green bodice featuring a pleated sweetheart neckline, a floral corsage, and a green gemstone choker.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A full, tiered mint green skirt with scalloped lace hems and floral embroidery, draped with a pink ribbon sash that cascades down the front, revealing frilly ivory bloomers beneath.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Detached white lace gloves with ribbon ties at the wrist, a woven straw hat, and scattered rose motifs.
